message.content:
Camp Nou’s current official seating capacity is **about 99,354** spectators.  
This figure reflects the latest post‑renovation configuration (the “new” Camp Nou), which reduced the original maximum of roughly 100,000 to accommodate modern safety standards, better sightlines, wider aisles, and improved amenities while still retaining its status as one of Europe’s largest football stadia.
